definitions.explanation: Relating to translation or conversion from Japanese to English.

examples.japanese: {和英|わえい}{辞典|じてん}で{調|しら}べる。
examples.english: To look it up in a Japanese-English dictionary.

examples.japanese: {和英|わえい}{翻訳|ほんやく}を{依頼|いらい}した。
オンラインの{和英|わえい}{辞書|じしょ}を{使|つか}う。
examples.english: To use an online Japanese-English dictionary.

notes:
{和英|わえい} (和 = Japanese + 英 = English)

CONTRAST:
- {英和|えいわ}: English-Japanese

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {和英|わえい}{辞典|じてん}/{辞書|じしょ}: Japanese-English dictionary
- {和英|わえい}{翻訳|ほんやく}: Japanese-to-English translation

NOTE: Used as a prefix to indicate Japanese-to-English direction.
